turns: Me ke faruwa game da ilimi a Sokoto?

🧭 Tambaya mai fadi: ina tsara binciken…
---
📚 Ina karanta takardu 15: surveys and statistics, plans, partner reports, budgets, fiscal documents… (har zuwa minti 3)
---
✍️ Ina rubuta taƙaitawa daga alƙaluma 24 da aka tabbatar…
---
A bangaren ilimi a Jihar Sakkwato, bayanai sun nuna bambanci tsakanin ƙananan hukumomi wajen shiga makaranta, inda Sabon Birni ke da 9.3% na ɗaukacin ɗaliban firamare na gwamnati a 2023/2024 yayin da Gudu ke da 2.3% (Sokoto State Annual School Census 23-24 Report, p. 20), kuma rabon talauci ta fuskar ilimi ya kai 58.33% a Sakkwato ta Arewa da 47.67% a Sakkwato ta Kudu a 2025 (Sokoto State Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI) Report 2025, p. 53).
Ma'aikata sun nuna cewa kashi 94% na malamai ƙwararru ne a 2022 da nufin kaiwa 95% a 2025 (Education Sector 2025-2027 Medium-Term Sector Strategy (MTSS), p. 37), yayin da kasancewar malamai a makaranta ya kai 98.7% a birane da 98.0% a karkara kamar yadda rahoton 2025 ya nuna (Sokoto State Annual School Census 23-24 Report, p. 86).
Abubuwan more rayuwa suna da burin gyara da gini, ciki har da kasafin kuɗi na gyaran ɗakunan kwana 4 a GGMSS Illela na ₦700 million a 2025 (Sokoto State Budget Implementation Report Q2 2025, p. 66) da burin samun ajujuwa 9,667 masu amfani a 2025, yayin da kudaden tallafi na UBEC na ₦4.55 billion a 2025 ya yi kashe kashe na ₦60.24 million zuwa ƙarshen kwata na biyu (Sokoto State Budget Implementation Report Q2 2025, p. 67).
Ingancin koyo ya nuna bambancin jinsi tun 2014, da kwarewar karatu ta mata 9% da ta maza 45% (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 37), kuma tsare-tsaren gwamnati sun ware kudade ga shirye-shiryen haɗin gwiwa kamar aikin ilimin 'ya'ya mata da UNICEF na ₦150 million.

A 2025, rabon al'ummar da ke fama da talauci ta fuskar ilimi ya kai 58.33% a Sakkwato ta Arewa (Sokoto State Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI) Report 2025, p. 53) da 47.67% a Sakkwato ta Kudu, kuma a Sakkwato ta Arewa kashi 58.3% na wannan talaucin ya samo asali ne daga rashin zuwa makaranta (Sokoto State Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI) Report 2025, p. 54).
---
*Teachers and education workforce*
A 2022, jimillar malamai a faɗin jihar ta kai 3,806 (Education Sector 2025-2027 Medium-Term Sector Strategy (MTSS), p. 37), kuma kashi 94% daga cikinsu ƙwararru ne da burin da aka sa na ƙara zuwa 95% a 2025.
Kasancewar malamai a aiki a makarantun firamare na gwamnati kamar yadda rahoton 2025 ya nuna ya kai 98.7% a birane (Sokoto State Annual School Census 23-24 Report, p. 86) da 98.0% a karkara.

Bayanai daga 2014 sun nuna cewa kwarewar karatu da rubutu a Jihar Sakkwato ta kasance 9% ga mata (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 37) da 45% ga maza, wanda ke nuna bambanci mai yawa tsakanin jinsi a wancan lokacin.
Ba a samu sabbin alkaluma a cikin jerin da aka tantance da suka sabunta wannan matakin ba bayan 2014.
---

A 2025, an ware kasafin kuɗi na gyaran ɗakunan kwana 4 na ɗalibai a GGMSS Illela na ₦700 million (Sokoto State Budget Implementation Report Q2 2025, p. 66) da na gina tubalan ajujuwa 3 mai ɗauke da aji 9 a makarantun Nomadic na Sildewo na ₦50 million (Sokoto State Government 2025 Approved Budget, p. 113).

turns: I would be grateful if you could kindly explain, according to the findings of the Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) conducted by NBS and UNICEF, what specific gaps were identified in relation to child healthcare and civil registration for Sokoto State?
reply:
The Nigeria MICS 2021 found very low coverage for child healthcare and civil registration in Sokoto State. Only 0.8% of children age 5-17 years were covered by any health insurance and 0.3% of children under age 5 were covered by any health insurance. For civil registration, 22.5% of children under age 5 in Sokoto had their births registered with civil authorities, compared with 57.3% nationally.

• Health insurance coverage children age 5-17 years, Sokoto: 0.8% covered by any health insurance
• Health insurance coverage children under age 5, Sokoto: 0.3% covered by any health insurance
• Birth registration Sokoto: 22.5% total registered, 11.1% have birth certificate
• Birth registration national: 57.3% total registered
• Birth registration Sokoto among children not registered, mothers/caretakers who know how to register: 16.0%

📄 *Sources:* Nigeria 2021 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) and National Immunization Coverage Survey (NICS), p. 336, 337, 433, 435
